findings.title: Whole-monitor capture vs region select
findings.detail: capture_primary_png_base64 grabs the entire primary monitor; on-screen region selection is deferred. This is a documented, deliberate M2 scope choice (comment in snip.rs + PENDING MANUAL in docs/m2-verification.md), not a defect. No action required for M2; track region-select UX as a host/interactive follow-up.
